負う: to take (responsibility); to assume; to accept; to bear (the blame, costs, etc.)
抜き: leaving out; omitting; skipping; dispensing with
放る: to neglect; to abandon; to leave alone; to give up on
籠もる: to shut oneself in (e.g. one's room); to be confined in; to seclude oneself; to hide away
びくびく: being afraid of; being fearful; being timid; being nervous
押し込む: to break in; to burgle; to burglarize
目障り: eyesore; offensive sight; offense to the eye
着せる: to put clothes on (someone); to dress; to clothe
明かす: to reveal; to divulge; to disclose; to expose
辿る: to follow (a clue, scent, tracks, plot, etc.); to trace (a route, history, family tree, etc.); to retrace (e.g. one's memory); to search

__flags__.跳ね: 跳ねっかえり (tomboy/rebellious person) compound, not 'jump'
